newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho ends merger talks with JCI.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho ends merger talks with JCI.

text.p: Mining conglomerate Lonrho Plc said on Monday it had discontinued talks with South Africa's JCI Ltd on a possible merger of the two groups.
Lonrho gave no further details in the statement. The companies said last month they were in preliminary discussions.
Last week, JCI declined to comment on newspaper reports saying the talks were close to breaking down.
A merger would have created a mining house with a market capitalisation of around three billion dollars.
Lonrho shares were down 4-1/2p at 127p in mid-morning trade in London.
Lonrho's plans for a streamlining of its operations, include the planned sale of its Princess hotels chain and the demerger of its African trading business.
